sentences.text:
Shri P.S. Kushwah, learned Penal Lawyer for   respondent/State.
Heard on the question of admission.
The petition is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.3504/2019 i.e. an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellants Rajendra Kumaar S/o Brijmohan.

A perusal of the record reveals that appellant stands convicted under Sections 7(1)(3)(a) r/w 16(1)(A)(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and has been sentenced to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/-, with default stipulation.
Taking into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I.A.No.3504/2019 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant is allowed.

It is directed that on deposition of fine amount and also on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before this Court/Registry on 16/09/2019 and on all other subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this behalf, the execution of substantial jail sentence imposed on the appellant shall remain suspended, till final disposal of this appeal.
List the matter be listed for final hearing in due course.
(Ms. Vandana Kasrekar) Judge amit Amit Kumar 2.5.4.20=18db6b55824fa1834dc7 e61d06ed3c79a81bc156ec0309c5 245d47a0a52604de, cn=Amit Kumar
